safety_review.findings: Fresh non-author reviewers, claude-sonnet-5-5 (three in parallel for the first read, then two confirm passes), read every weigh line in the ten step 1-4 banks on 2026-11-26 after the weigh-bridge rewrite (each step 1-4 คิดต่อ / Next thought line is now a question that turns the visitor, from the answer just chosen, toward what the next step asks), all three alternatives, Thai and English, against every question variant of its own bank and of the bank the option leads to. Strength, safety and every step 5 line are byte-identical to the bank reviewed on 2026-11-25 (checked by script). No line was found unsafe or to nudge toward harm. Must-fixes applied: step1 lines paraphrased "Weight and dehydration signs" ("grade how dry", "bedside signs"), and "before any fluid goes in" could read as delaying ORS; step3 [1] "what does her mother need to carry on at home" echoed the teach-the-mother option; step4 "at home" lines presumed discharge, the very step 5 decision, and sat against the admit-best step5.R scenario, now ask how fluid losses will be replaced; "not safe to leave" was the danger-sign teaching line, and its replacement "if she is well at this recheck" misfit the paths where she is not, now "Once the next recheck shows her improving" on those paths; step3 [2] "which signs will show she is rehydrated" fit poorly where step 4 shows her still slightly dry, now asks which signs show she is not yet rehydrated. Should-fix taken: Thai missing "ได้". Every replacement was re-read against all variants in a later pass, and the last pass left no must-fix open. Second round, same day: an independent Opus re-read of the committed lines found six failing lines in a sample of 30, and seven fixes were applied as given (leptospirosis step4.W.d [0] and [2], adhf step4.W.reservoir [1], motorcycle-shock step1.e [0], step3 c [0] and step2 a/b [2], alcohol-pancreatitis step3 [2]); on the FAST paths the English says "fluid and transfusion" instead of "fluid and blood", because the checker rejects "blood" (another option label). Then three fresh claude-sonnet-5-5 reviewers that had seen no earlier pass read every step 1-4 alternative in the ten banks (1467 alternatives, 2934 lines), each against its own bank, its own strength and safety lines, and the next bank's variants, options and explanation lines, failing any wait, overnight or next-days framing where the case is urgent, any claim not in the case, any echo of the next best option, a Thai/English mismatch and unnatural Thai. 156 read, 6 failed: "by morning" and "overnight" lines on step4.R.iv, R.abxb and W.ivculture; the confirm pass found "still dry" contradicted a next-step variant, now "After this step, where is the safest place to continue her care?".
